test.name: England survey records that the indexed christenings collection is a partial Legacy index
test.description: Issue #4516 moves search-records' collection quirks onto the wiki path: locality-guide reads the FamilySearch Wiki and records the quirk in localities[].quirks, research-plan writes it into the plan item, and search-records follows the plan item. This test grades the first step for England: the survey must persist a localities entry whose quirks carry the rule from https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/England,_Births_and_Christenings_-_FamilySearch_Historical_Records. Fixtures are live captures (2026-11-15); none is hand-written.

input.delegation:
We're researching christenings and marriages in Lincolnshire, England, 1750-1800, using FamilySearch's indexed parish-register collections. Produce the locality research guide and save it to the project.

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: Read-coverage is enforced deterministically by the validator (`test_localities_persisted_with_full_page_coverage` checks a localities[] entry was persisted with `pages_read` covering all four wiki sections). Do NOT independently re-count wiki_place_page calls — grade the persisted entry's substance.

The quirk under test (issue #4516): FamilySearch's England, Births and Christenings collection (the indexed christenings, 1538-1975) is a partial Legacy index: it does not index all records for a place or period, and no records or corrections are being added, so a nil in it is a statement about the index, not proof that no christening exists. Source: https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/England,_Births_and_Christenings_-_FamilySearch_Historical_Records — 'This collection is a partial index of records for this locality. … As no additional records will be added, or any corrections made to the data, this is considered to be a "Legacy" collection' and 'It does not index all records for this place, record type or time period.' Supporting page: https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/International_Genealogical_Index ('Sometimes only portions of parish records or other sources were indexed.')

How the page reaches the agent: The wiki_search fixture (captured live for 'England parish registers christenings index', served for any query containing 'England') returns this page among its results, and its chunk carries the Legacy notice; the wiki_read fixtures serve this page and the IGI page in full.

Correctness and Completeness turn on the persisted research.json: the new localities[] entry's `quirks` array must include a quirk carrying this rule (paraphrase is fine; citing the page URL is good practice). A run that states the rule only in guide_markdown or in its reply, and not in `quirks`, fails this point: research-plan reads `quirks`, not the guide.
Do not credit a quirk with coverage figures or batch-number claims these pages do not make.
The skill must NOT write to any research.json section other than `localities`, and must not touch tree.gedcomx.json.
